description: Intentional changes to frozen first-party UI files. Each entry records the original hash, the reviewed hash, why it changed, and which tests cover the behavior.

assets.reason: sendMessage, runAssistantTurn and driveAssistantSse split into named functions of 60 lines or fewer, with awaits kept at the same points so sends and turns start in the same tick as before. A finished failed reply refreshes its Retry action. A rejected unlock passphrase is selected so typing again replaces it. Live thinking text skips the Markdown cache.

A failed last reply gets a visible Retry action that re-sends the user's message through the existing unchanged-edit path. Rendered Markdown is cached (bounded, never for streaming text, cleared on lock) so reopening a long chat does not parse every reply again.
Stream start and end refresh Retry actions, so Retry hides while a turn runs.

When the chat column is narrow (sidebar and Activity open), the composer uses the existing compact Branch button and keeps its tools on one row instead of stacking them; the empty capabilities label stays on one line. On touch screens the capability chip remove button gets a larger invisible tap area that does not cover the label.
verifiedBy: Visual check at 1024px with sidebar and Activity open, idle and streaming

assets.reason: Style for the always-visible Retry action on a failed reply, matching the other message actions. On touch screens the code copy button gets a larger invisible tap area.
verifiedBy: Visual check of a failed reply

assets.reason: Locking encrypted data also clears the rendered-Markdown cache, which holds decrypted chat text.
